entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_2 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] [StandardBorelSpace 𝓐] [Nonempty 𝓐] [StandardBorelSpace Ω] [Countable 𝓐], Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A R alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P → ∀ (a : 𝓐) (m : ℕ), m ≠ 0 → ⇑𝓛[Learning.rewardByCount A R a m | fun ω => Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1; P.prod (Bandits.streamMeasure ν)] =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω => Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1) (P.prod (Bandits.streamMeasure ν))] ⇑(ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.const ℕ∞ (ν a))

entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_2 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {n : ℕ} {a : 𝓐} [Nonempty 𝓐] [Countable 𝓐] [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {σ2 : NNReal}, 0 < σ2 → ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF (fun x => x - ∫ (x : ℝ), id x ∂ν a) σ2 (ν a) → Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A R alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P → ∀ {δ : ℝ}, 0 < δ → P {ω | ∃ t < n, Learning.pullCount A a t ω ≠ 0 ∧ √(2 * ↑(Learning.pullCount A a t ω) * ↑σ2 * Real.log (1 / δ)) ≤ Learning.sumRewards A R a t ω - ↑(Learning.pullCount A a t ω) * ∫ (x : ℝ), id x ∂ν a} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((↑n - 1) * δ)

entries.name: Bandits.prob_sumRewards_sub_pullCount_mul_ge_le_of_Fintype
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_2 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {n : ℕ} [Nonempty 𝓐] [inst_4 : Fintype 𝓐] [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {σ2 : NNReal}, 0 < σ2 → (∀ (a : 𝓐), ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF (fun x => x - ∫ (x : ℝ), id x ∂ν a) σ2 (ν a)) → Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A R alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P → ∀ {δ : ℝ}, 0 < δ → P {ω | ∃ a, ∃ t < n, Learning.pullCount A a t ω ≠ 0 ∧ √(2 * ↑(Learning.pullCount A a t ω) * ↑σ2 * Real.log (1 / δ)) ≤ Learning.sumRewards A R a t ω - ↑(Learning.pullCount A a t ω) * ∫ (x : ℝ), id x ∂ν a} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (↑(Fintype.card 𝓐) * (↑n - 1) * δ)

entries.name: Bandits.prob_sumRewards_sub_pullCount_mul_le_le
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_2 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {n : ℕ} {a : 𝓐} [Nonempty 𝓐] [Countable 𝓐] [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] {σ2 : NNReal}, 0 < σ2 → ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF (fun x => x - ∫ (x : ℝ), id x ∂ν a) σ2 (ν a) → Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A R alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P → ∀ {δ : ℝ}, 0 < δ → P {ω | ∃ t < n, Learning.pullCount A a t ω ≠ 0 ∧ Learning.sumRewards A R a t ω - ↑(Learning.pullCount A a t ω) * ∫ (x : ℝ), id x ∂ν a ≤ -√(2 * ↑(Learning.pullCount A a t ω) * ↑σ2 * Real.log (1 / δ))} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((↑n - 1) * δ)

entries.name: Bandits.prob_sum_ge_sqrt_log
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {n : ℕ} {σ2 : NNReal}, (∀ (a : 𝓐), ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF (fun x => x - ∫ (x : ℝ), id x ∂ν a) σ2 (ν a)) → σ2 ≠ 0 → ∀ {c : ℝ}, 0 ≤ c → ∀ (a : 𝓐) (k : ℕ), k ≠ 0 → (Bandits.streamMeasure ν) {ω | √(2 * c * ↑k * ↑σ2 * Real.log (↑n + 1)) ≤ ∑ s ∈ Finset.range k, (ω s a - ∫ (x : ℝ), id x ∂ν a)} ≤ 1 / (↑n + 1) ^ c

entries.name: Bandits.prob_sum_le_sqrt_log

entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] (n : ℕ) (h : ↥(Finset.Iic n) → 𝓐 × R) (a : 𝓐), Learning.pullCount' n h a = ∑ s, if (h s).1 = a then 1 else 0

entries.name: Learning.pullCount'_mono
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {ω : Ω} {n m : ℕ}, n ≤ m → Learning.pullCount' n (fun i => (A (↑i) ω, R' (↑i) ω)) a ≤ Learning.pullCount' m (fun i => (A (↑i) ω, R' (↑i) ω)) a

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_action_eq_pullCount_add_one
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω), Learning.pullCount A (A t ω) (t + 1) ω = Learning.pullCount A (A t ω) t ω + 1

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_add_one
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {t : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.pullCount A a (t + 1) ω = Learning.pullCount A a t ω + if A t ω = a then 1 else 0

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_add_one_eq_of_stepsUntil_eq_coe
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m n : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = ↑n → Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω = m

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_add_one_eq_pullCount'
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {n : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω = Learning.pullCount' n (fun i => (A (↑i) ω, R' (↑i) ω)) a

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_congr
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {n : ℕ} {ω ω' : Ω}, (∀ i ≤ n, A i ω = A i ω') → Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω = Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω'

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_eq_of_stepsUntil_eq_coe
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m n : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, m ≠ 0 → Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = ↑n → Learning.pullCount A a n ω = m - 1

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_eq_pullCount'
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {n : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, n ≠ 0 → Learning.pullCount A a n ω = Learning.pullCount' (n - 1) (fun i => (A (↑i) ω, R' (↑i) ω)) a

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_eq_pullCount_of_action_ne
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {t : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, A t ω ≠ a → Learning.pullCount A a (t + 1) ω = Learning.pullCount A a t ω

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_eq_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω), Learning.pullCount A a t ω = ∑ s ∈ Finset.range t, if A s ω = a then 1 else 0

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_le
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω), Learning.pullCount A a t ω ≤ t

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_le_add
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) (n C : ℕ) (ω : Ω), Learning.pullCount A a n ω ≤ C + 1 + ∑ s ∈ Finset.range n, {s | A s ω = a ∧ C < Learning.pullCount A a s ω}.indicator 1 s

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_lt_of_forall_ne
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {n t : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, (∀ (s : ℕ), Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω ≠ t) → t ≠ 0 → Learning.pullCount A a n ω < t

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_lt_of_le_stepsUntil
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) {n m : ℕ} (ω : Ω), (∃ s, Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω = m) → ↑n < Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω → Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω < m

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_mono
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) {n m : ℕ}, n ≤ m → ∀ (ω : Ω), Learning.pullCount A a n ω ≤ Learning.pullCount A a m ω

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_one
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {ω : Ω}, Learning.pullCount A a 1 ω = if A 0 ω = a then 1 else 0

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_stepsUntil
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, m ≠ 0 → (∃ s, Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω = m) → Learning.pullCount A a (Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω).toNat ω = m - 1

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_stepsUntil_add_one
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, (∃ s, Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω = m) → Learning.pullCount A a (Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω + 1).toNat ω = m

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_zero

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_zero_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) (ω : Ω), Learning.pullCount A a 0 ω = 0

entries.name: Learning.randomSampling_p0
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {𝓨 : Type u_2} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure 𝓐) [inst : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ], (Learning.randomSampling μ).p0 = μ

entries.name: Learning.randomSampling_policy
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {𝓨 : Type u_2} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure 𝓐) [inst : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (x : ℕ), (Learning.randomSampling μ).policy x = ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.const (↥(Finset.Iic x) → 𝓐 × 𝓨) μ

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount
entries.statement: {𝓐 : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → {Ω : Type u_3} → [DecidableEq 𝓐] → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓐) → (ℕ → Ω → R) → 𝓐 → ℕ → Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R) → R

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_eq_add
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} [inst_1 : AddMonoid R] (a : 𝓐) (m : ℕ), Learning.rewardByCount A R' a m = ({ω | Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 ≠ ⊤}.indicator fun ω => R' (Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1).toNat ω.1) + {ω | Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 = ⊤}.indicator fun ω => ω.2 m a

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_eq_ite
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} (a : 𝓐) (m : ℕ) (ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)), Learning.rewardByCount A R' a m ω = if Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 = ⊤ then ω.2 m a else R' (Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1).toNat ω.1

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_eq_stoppedValue
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 ≠ ⊤ → Learning.rewardByCount A R' a m ω = MeasureTheory.stoppedValue R' (Learning.stepsUntil A a m) ω.1

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_coe
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {m n : ℕ} {ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 = ↑n → Learning.rewardByCount A R' a m ω = R' n ω.1

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_top
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 = ⊤ → Learning.rewardByCount A R' a m ω = ω.2 m a

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_ne_top
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 ≠ ⊤ → Learning.rewardByCount A R' a m ω = R' (Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1).toNat ω.1

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_pullCount_add_one_eq_reward
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)), Learning.rewardByCount A R' (A t ω.1) (Learning.pullCount A (A t ω.1) t ω.1 + 1) ω = R' t ω.1

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} (a : 𝓐) (ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)), Learning.rewardByCount A R' a 0 ω = if A 0 ω.1 = a then ω.2 0 a else R' 0 ω.1

entries.name: Learning.roundRobinAlgorithm

entries.name: Learning.snd_eval_comp_history
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {𝓨 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨} (n : ℕ), (fun x => (x ⟨n, ⋯⟩).2) ∘ Learning.history A Y n = Y n

entries.name: Learning.stationaryEnv

entries.statement: {𝓐 : Type u_1} → {𝓨 : Type u_2} → {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} → {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} → Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 𝓨 → Learning.Environment 𝓐 𝓨 → (n : ℕ) → ProbabilityTheory.Kernel (↥(Finset.Iic n) → 𝓐 × 𝓨) (𝓐 × 𝓨)

entries.name: Learning.stepKernel_def
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {𝓨 : Type u_2} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 𝓨) (env : Learning.Environment 𝓐 𝓨) (n : ℕ), Learning.stepKernel alg env n = (alg.policy n).compProd (env.feedback n)

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil
entries.statement: {𝓐 : Type u_1} → {Ω : Type u_3} → [DecidableEq 𝓐] → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓐) → 𝓐 → ℕ → Ω → ℕ∞

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_congr
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m n : ℕ} {ω ω' : Ω}, (∀ i ≤ n, A i ω = A i ω') → (Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = ↑n ↔ Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω' = ↑n)

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_dite
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) (m : ℕ) (ω : Ω) [inst_1 : Decidable (∃ s, Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω = m)], Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = if h : ∃ s, Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω = m then ↑(Nat.find h) else ⊤

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_iff
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω} (n : ℕ), Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = ↑n ↔ Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω = m ∧ ∀ k < n, Learning.pullCount A a (k + 1) ω < m

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_iff'
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, m ≠ 0 → ∀ (n : ℕ), Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = ↑n ↔ A n ω = a ∧ Learning.pullCount A a n ω = m - 1

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_leastGE
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {m : ℕ} (a : 𝓐), m ≠ 0 → Learning.stepsUntil A a m = MeasureTheory.leastGE (fun n ω => Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω) m

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_top_iff
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = ⊤ ↔ ∀ (s : ℕ), Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω ≠ m

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_zero_iff
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = 0 ↔ m = 0 ∧ A 0 ω ≠ a ∨ m = 1 ∧ A 0 ω = a

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_mono
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) (ω : Ω) {n m : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → n ≤ m → Learning.stepsUntil A a n ω ≤ Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_ne_top
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, (∃ s, Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω = m) → Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω ≠ ⊤

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_one_of_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {ω : Ω}, A 0 ω = a → Learning.stepsUntil A a 1 ω = 0

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_pullCount_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (ω : Ω) (t : ℕ), Learning.stepsUntil A (A t ω) (Learning.pullCount A (A t ω) (t + 1) ω) ω = ↑t

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_pullCount_le
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (ω : Ω) (a : 𝓐) (t : ℕ), Learning.stepsUntil A a (Learning.pullCount A a (t + 1) ω) ω ≤ ↑t

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_zero_of_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {ω : Ω}, A 0 ω = a → Learning.stepsUntil A a 0 ω = ⊤

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_zero_of_ne
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {ω : Ω}, A 0 ω ≠ a → Learning.stepsUntil A a 0 ω = 0

entries.name: Learning.stronglyAdapted_pullCount_add_one
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {mR : MeasurableSpace R} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 R} {env : Learning.Environment 𝓐 R} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A R' alg env P) (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.StronglyAdapted h.filtration fun n => Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1)

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards'
entries.statement: {𝓐 : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq 𝓐] → (n : ℕ) → (↥(Finset.Iic n) → 𝓐 × ℝ) → 𝓐 → ℝ

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards_add_one
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {t : ℕ} {ω : Ω} {R' : ℕ → Ω → ℝ}, Learning.sumRewards A R' a (t + 1) ω = Learning.sumRewards A R' a t ω + if A t ω = a then R' t ω else 0

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards_add_one_eq_sumRewards'
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {n : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.sumRewards A R' a (n + 1) ω = Learning.sumRewards' n (fun i => (A (↑i) ω, R' (↑i) ω)) a

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards_eq_of_pullCount_eq

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards_eq_pullCount_mul_empMean

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards_sub_pullCount_mul_eq_sum

entries.name: Bandits.TS.integral_regret_eq_add
entries.statement: ∀ {K : ℕ} [inst : Nonempty (Fin K)] {l u σ2 δ : ℝ} {Ω : Type u_1} [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace Ω] {𝓔 : Type u_2} [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace 𝓔] [inst_3 : StandardBorelSpace 𝓔] [inst_4 : Nonempty 𝓔] {Q : MeasureTheory.Measure 𝓔} [inst_5 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure Q] {κ : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel (𝓔 × Fin K) ℝ} [inst_6 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel κ] {E : Ω → 𝓔} {A : ℕ → Ω → Fin K} {R : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_7 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (hK : 0 < K), Learning.IsBayesAlgEnvSeq Q κ (Bandits.tsAlgorithm hK Q κ) E A R P → (∀ (e : 𝓔) (a : Fin K), ∫ (x : ℝ), id x ∂κ (e, a) ∈ Set.Icc l u) → ∀ (n : ℕ), ∫ (x : Ω), Learning.IsBayesAlgEnvSeq.regret κ E A n x ∂P = ∫ (x : Ω), (fun ω => ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, (Learning.IsBayesAlgEnvSeq.actionMean κ E (Learning.IsBayesAlgEnvSeq.bestAction κ E ω) ω - Bandits.ClippedUCB.ucb A R l u σ2 δ (Learning.IsBayesAlgEnvSeq.bestAction κ E ω) t ω)) x ∂P + ∫ (x : Ω), (fun ω => ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, (Bandits.ClippedUCB.ucb A R l u σ2 δ (A t ω) t ω - Learning.IsBayesAlgEnvSeq.actionMean κ E (A t ω) ω)) x ∂P

entries.name: Bandits.TS.integral_regret_le
entries.statement: ∀ {K : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin K)] {l u σ2 : ℝ} {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {𝓔 : Type u_2} [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace 𝓔] [inst_2 : StandardBorelSpace 𝓔] [inst_3 : Nonempty 𝓔] {Q : MeasureTheory.Measure 𝓔} [inst_4 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure Q] {κ : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel (𝓔 × Fin K) ℝ} [inst_5 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel κ] {E : Ω → 𝓔} {A : ℕ → Ω → Fin K} {R : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_6 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (hK : 0 < K), Learning.IsBayesAlgEnvSeq Q κ (Bandits.tsAlgorithm hK Q κ) E A R P → l ≤ u → (∀ (e : 𝓔) (a : Fin K), ∫ (x : ℝ), id x ∂κ (e, a) ∈ Set.Icc l u) → ∀ (hσ2 : 0 < σ2), (∀ (e : 𝓔) (a : Fin K), ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF (fun x => x - ∫ (x : ℝ), id x ∂κ (e, a)) ⟨σ2, ⋯⟩ (κ (e, a))) → ∀ (n : ℕ), ∫ (x : Ω), Learning.IsBayesAlgEnvSeq.regret κ E A n x ∂P ≤ (2 * ↑K + 1) * (u - l) + 8 * √(σ2 * ↑K * ↑n * Real.log ↑n)

entries.name: Bandits.UCB.pullCount_ae_le_add_two
entries.statement: ∀ {K : ℕ} {hK : 0 < K} {c : ℝ} {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel (Fin K) ℝ} [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → Fin K} {R : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {σ2 : NNReal} [inst_2 : Nonempty (Fin K)], Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A R (Bandits.ucbAlgorithm hK (c * ↑σ2)) (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P → 0 ≤ c → ∀ (a : Fin K), 0 < Bandits.gap ν a → ∀ (n C : ℕ), C ≠ 0 → 8 * c * ↑σ2 * Real.log (↑n + 1) / Bandits.gap ν a ^ 2 ≤ ↑C → ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, Learning.pullCount A a n ω ≤ C + 1 + ∑ s ∈ Finset.range n, {s | 0 < Learning.pullCount A (Bandits.bestArm ν) s ω ∧ Learning.empMean A R (Bandits.bestArm ν) s ω + Bandits.UCB.ucbWidth A (c * ↑σ2) (Bandits.bestArm ν) s ω < ∫ (x : ℝ), id x ∂ν (Bandits.bestArm ν)}.indicator 1 s + ∑ s ∈ Finset.range n, {s | 0 < Learning.pullCount A a s ω ∧ ∫ (x : ℝ), id x ∂ν a < Learning.empMean A R a s ω - Bandits.UCB.ucbWidth A (c * ↑σ2) a s ω}.indicator 1 s

entries.name: ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.sub_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} [inst : MeasurableSpace.CountableOrCountablyGenerated α β] {κ η : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α β} [inst_1 : (η : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α β) → Decidable (ProbabilityTheory.IsSFiniteKernel η)] [ProbabilityTheory.IsFiniteKernel κ] [ProbabilityTheory.IsFiniteKernel η] (a : α), (κ - η) a = κ a - η a

entries.name: ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.sub_apply_eq_rnDeriv_add_singularPart
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} [inst : MeasurableSpace.CountableOrCountablyGenerated α β] {κ η : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α β} [inst_1 : (η : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α β) → Decidable (ProbabilityTheory.IsSFiniteKernel η)] [inst_2 : ProbabilityTheory.IsSFiniteKernel κ] [inst_3 : ProbabilityTheory.IsSFiniteKernel η] (a : α), (κ - η) a = (η.withDensity fun a => κ.rnDeriv η a - 1) a + (κ.singularPart η) a

entries.name: ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.sub_apply_eq_zero_iff_le
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} [inst : MeasurableSpace.CountableOrCountablyGenerated α β] {κ η : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α β} [inst_1 : (η : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α β) → Decidable (ProbabilityTheory.IsSFiniteKernel η)] [ProbabilityTheory.IsFiniteKernel κ] [ProbabilityTheory.IsFiniteKernel η] (a : α), (κ - η) a = 0 ↔ κ a ≤ η a

entries.name: ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.sub_def
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} [inst : MeasurableSpace.CountableOrCountablyGenerated α β] {κ η : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α β} [inst_1 : (η : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α β) → Decidable (ProbabilityTheory.IsSFiniteKernel η)], κ - η = if h : ProbabilityTheory.IsSFiniteKernel κ ∧ ProbabilityTheory.IsSFiniteKernel η then have this := ⋯; have this_1 := ⋯; (η.withDensity fun a => κ.rnDeriv η a - 1) + κ.singularPart η else 0

entries.name: ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.sub_eq_zero_iff_le
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} [inst : MeasurableSpace.CountableOrCountablyGenerated α β] {κ η : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α β} [inst_1 : (η : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α β) → Decidable (ProbabilityTheory.IsSFiniteKernel η)] [ProbabilityTheory.IsFiniteKernel κ] [ProbabilityTheory.IsFiniteKernel η], κ - η = 0 ↔ κ ≤ η

entries.name: ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.trajMeasure_map_frestrictLe
entries.statement: ∀ {X : ℕ → Type u_2} [inst : (n : ℕ) → MeasurableSpace (X n)] {κ : (n : ℕ) → ProbabilityTheory.Kernel ((i : ↥(Finset.Iic n)) → X ↑i) (X (n + 1))} [inst_1 : ∀ (n : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel (κ n)] {μ₀ : MeasureTheory.Measure (X 0)} (n : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (Preorder.frestrictLe n) (ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.trajMeasure μ₀ κ) = (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (⇑(MeasurableEquiv.piUnique fun i => X ↑i).symm) μ₀).bind ⇑(ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.partialTraj κ 0 n)

entries.name: ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.traj_zero_map_eval_zero

entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} {Z : Type u_4} [inst : MeasurableSpace X] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace Y] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace Z] (SX SY SZ : SFinKer) (ex : SX.carrier ≃ᵐ X) (ey : SY.carrier ≃ᵐ Y) (ez : SZ.carrier ≃ᵐ Z) (κ : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel X Y) [inst_3 : ProbabilityTheory.IsSFiniteKernel κ], CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.whiskerLeft SZ κ.hom = (ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.id.parallelComp κ).hom
